analysis: AA-7 human-supported trait convergence and cross-model aligned-subspace study

comparators.direct_semantic_45: All AA-1 primary_direct / ACCEPT_DIRECT traits; descriptive larger human-semantic comparator
comparators.externally_anchored_big_five_5: AA-2 human_anchored_strict raw_projection_score definitions without rebuilding or retuning
comparators.full_real_240: All canonical raw activation-cosine trait scores
comparators.geometry_optimized_12: AA-4 joint greedy forward-selection method reproduced within every outer-training partition at k=12
comparators.isotropic_12: Independent normalized Gaussian ambient directions, target-independent
comparators.persona_span_12: Gaussian directions in each centered outer-training role span, with held-out roles excluded from construction
comparators.random_real_12: Uniform subsets without replacement from the 240 real trait directions, selected without targets

contribution_diagnostics.conditional_permutation: Permute one fixed trait column only within each untouched outer-test fold; deterministic trait/fold seeds
contribution_diagnostics.leave_one_trait_out: Re-evaluate the fixed 12-trait family after removing exactly one trait; no replacement or subset optimization
contribution_diagnostics.standardized_coefficients: Full-data descriptive Ridge after four-fold alpha selection; both X and Y standardized

phase_1.family_holdout: Use the fixed Qwen-canonical role-family labels for all three shared-role models; tune alpha only inside remaining families
phase_1.feature_definition: Existing same-model raw activation cosine; within-model z-scores and percentiles are descriptive only

fixed_family_evaluation.inner_cv: 4-fold shuffled KFold inside each outer training partition
fixed_family_evaluation.purpose: Matched empirical comparisons among human-supported and all random/generic banks

phase_1.geometry_optimized_evaluation: Nested forward selection and alpha choice occur inside each fixed outer fold; no outer-test role enters selection
phase_1.lopo: Leave each of 275 personas out once; four-fold shuffled inner alpha tuning with seed 10000 + held-out index

metrics.aggregate_normalized_geometric_error: sqrt(mean over held-out roles of the sum over included PCs of squared residual divided by that role's outer-training PC standard deviation))
metrics.normalized_rmse_per_pc: sqrt(mean squared held-out residual divided by fold-local outer-training PC standard deviation)

phase_1.primary_inference: For each model and target scope, compare human_supported_12 aggregate normalized geometric error on the fixed outer splits with each matched bank distribution; lower error is better

evidence_strength_rule.cross_model_strong: Human-supported 12 beats both random-real and persona-span controls at empirical p <= 0.05 in all three models for both target scopes
evidence_strength_rule.cross_model_moderate: Human-supported 12 beats random-real at empirical p <= 0.05 in at least two models for both scopes, with no claim of unique semantic privilege unless persona-span is also beaten
evidence_strength_rule.weak_or_absent: The cross-model-moderate rule is not met

phase_1.later_human_respondent_projection_design: A later design is justified, but not executed, only if human-supported 12 beats both random-real and persona-span at p <= 0.05 in at least two models for both scopes, neither remaining model shows worse-than-median random-real performance in either scope, both Qwen-reference alignment pairs beat their permutation nulls at p <= 0.05, and at least six frozen traits achieve MODERATE or HIGH cross-model recurrence in PC1-PC6

random_controls.empirical_one_sided_p: (1 + number of null banks with error <= human-supported error) / 501
random_controls.empirical_percentile: 100 * number of null banks with error >= human-supported error / 500

phase_1.ridge_preprocessing: Within every inner and outer fit, center/scale X from training rows and center/scale Y from training rows only

support_utility_test.primary_descriptive_utility: mean squared Pearson association with the included model-local PCs
support_utility_test.secondary_utility: maximum absolute Pearson association with the included model-local PCs

agreeableness_decision_rule.partially_reconciled: mean aligned pairwise cosine >= 0.50 but minimum pairwise cosine < 0.50
agreeableness_decision_rule.reconciled: mean aligned pairwise cosine >= 0.70 and minimum pairwise cosine >= 0.50

alignment_cv.inner_operation: Fit centering, optional scaling, and orthogonal Procrustes rotation on training roles only; transform held-out source coordinates

alignment_variants.primary: raw PC scores, training-centered, preserving model-local PC variance

phase_2.core_vs_extended_material_improvement: Mean pairwise aligned direction cosine increases by at least 0.10 for a feature family when moving from PC1-PC3 to PC1-PC6
phase_2.direction_projection: Regress each centered model trait-role score vector on that model's centered local PC score basis to obtain a coefficient vector; unit-normalize it; for source-to-reference alignment Y ~= X R, transform coefficients as R transpose times the local coefficient

direction_recurrence_thresholds.HIGH CROSS-MODEL RECURRENCE: mean pairwise cosine >= 0.75 and minimum pairwise cosine >= 0.60
direction_recurrence_thresholds.MODERATE: mean pairwise cosine >= 0.50 and minimum pairwise cosine >= 0.25

phase_2.full_fit_use: Full 275-role transforms are used only to express final trait directions in one reference coordinate system; alignment evidence is evaluated held-out

null.test: Globally permute source role labels, then fit/evaluate alignment with a fixed 5-fold split seed 7100
null.validity: Role labels are permuted before fitting; no held-out target role enters the fitted transform
